import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem iterate_cauchy
  {α ι : Type*} [UniformSpace α] [Preorder ι]
  {f : α → α} {u : ι → α}
  (hf : UniformContinuous f) (hu : CauchySeq u) :
  ∀ n : ℕ, CauchySeq ((f^[n]) ∘ u) := by
  have h_map : ∀ {v : ι → α} (g : α → α), UniformContinuous g → CauchySeq v → CauchySeq (g ∘ v) := by
    intro v g hg hv
    rw [CauchySeq, ← Filter.map_map]
    exact hv.map hg
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hu
  | succ n ih =>
    have : (f^[n + 1]) ∘ u = f ∘ ((f^[n]) ∘ u) := by
      ext x
      exact Function.iterate_succ_apply' f n (u x)
    rw [this]
    exact h_map f hf ih

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem iterate_cauchy
  {α ι : Type*} [UniformSpace α] [Preorder ι]
  {f : α → α} {u : ι → α}
  (hf : UniformContinuous f) (hu : CauchySeq u) :
  ∀ n : ℕ, CauchySeq ((f^[n]) ∘ u) := by
  have hmain :
      ∀ n : ℕ, UniformContinuous (f^[n]) ∧ CauchySeq ((f^[n]) ∘ u) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        constructor
        · simpa using (uniformContinuous_id : UniformContinuous (id : α → α))
        · simpa using hu
    | succ n ih =>
        have hfu : CauchySeq (f ∘ u) :=
          hf.comp_cauchySeq hu
        have hc : CauchySeq ((f^[n]) ∘ (f ∘ u)) :=
          ih.1.comp_cauchySeq hfu
        constructor
        · exact ih.1.comp hf
        · simpa [Function.comp_def, Function.iterate_succ_apply] using hc
  intro n
  exact (hmain n).2

import Aesop

theorem iterate_cauchy
  {α ι : Type*} [UniformSpace α] [Preorder ι]

  (hf : UniformContinuous f) (hu : CauchySeq u) :
  ∀ n : ℕ, CauchySeq ((f^[n]) ∘ u) := by
  intro n

      rw [← Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
